summary: Nuwellis, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a settlement agreement with E.F. Hutton Co. to resolve a breach-of-contract suit related to an engagement letter for exclusive placement agent services. The Company agreed to pay $204,000 with no admission of liability; the parties exchanged mutual releases and Hutton will dismiss the case with prejudice. This is a routine litigation settlement, not a special situation like a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. No transaction terms, strategic review, or capital return are involved. The event has no risk-arb angle; it merely closes a legal dispute.
